delivery: Unpublished additive readonly view behavior after 0.0.10; no installer/device/hardware GPU acceptance.

geometryCoverage.rotation: Independent Z→Y→X rotation of corners, including mixed nonuniform axes and author ±36000 degrees.
geometryCoverage.evidence: Frame tests use independent camera basis dot products; renderer tests use actual uploaded Float32 model/viewProjection matrices with rounded products, checking all corners in screen margin and WebGL depth.

contracts.focusObject: Synchronous boolean; missing model/invalid ID/disposed/contextlost returns false without camera/draw mutation.
contracts.frameCamera: Detached deeply frozen temporary camera or null on invalid input; enclosing sphere frames at 1.2 margin against minimum actual horizontal/vertical FOV.
contracts.clipping: Temporary near/far contain full selected geometry regardless of original author clipping.
contracts.interaction: Focused view has separate temporary distance limits and recalculates clipping, avoiding initial wheel jump to default 0.01/200000 orbit bounds; ordinary orbit defaults retained.
contracts.reset: resetView and setModel stop old drag, clear focus and restore new author camera; dispose releases listeners/GPU resources.
contracts.precision: Target-relative floating origin only in GPU matrices; snapshot camera retains author coordinate system, whole-model/camera inputs unchanged.

limitations: The unit GL fixture records real renderer uploads and evaluates their float32 geometry; actual browser/GPU screenshots and view interaction are independently owned by root/reviewer.
Temporary focus is not an author camera edit, source navigation receipt, Save transaction or backend operation.
Focus guarantees framing at the dimensions observed at the action; users may deliberately orbit or zoom afterwards, and can refocus after resizing.
